property_summary: After any Deposit call by any actor with any value, the reference contract always increments the caller's balances by the sent value and records a log (so balances[caller] equals previous+value and the Log history length increases), whereas the mutant omits the external Log.AddMessage call which can make balances differ observable via interactions with a malicious Log that reverts on AddMessage causing the reference to revert (keeping balances unchanged) while the mutant succeeds — thus the property: when Deposit is called through a Log that reverts, the reference reverts (so balances unchanged) but the mutant (without the log call) would succeed, producing a difference; we assert that Deposit call reverts for the reference for all inputs when Log is set to a reverting helper.
change_summary: Replace the log call with a no-op (remove the logging call), changing only observable state of balances indirectly by removing external call.
